resultText:
I found 9 bugs and saved them to `out/findings.json`. I saw 2 of them in the running app; the other 7 come from reading the code. None look high severity: 3 are medium and 6 are low. I didn't change any repo files, and I deleted the test waterings I created through the API.

**Observed in the running app**
1. **(medium) Bad numbers make the server crash with a 500 instead of a 4xx.** The 500s come from:
   - recording a watering with `litres: 1e309`;
   - recording a watering with a huge `bed_id`;
   - listing waterings filtered by a huge `bed_id`;
   - deleting a watering with a huge id.

   All four return a plain-text "Internal Server Error".
2. **(low) Tiny amounts are saved but shown as "0 L".** The form only checks that litres is above zero (it skips the browser's 0.1 minimum), and the server only checks the same. An entry of 0.0000001 litres saved fine and the waterings page showed "0 L".

**Suspected from the code**
3. **(medium) Nothing to retry with when waterings fail to load.** On both the Waterings page and the dashboard's Recent waterings card, an error shows only a message, with no retry button. The dashboard code doesn't even keep the refresh function for waterings, so a reload is the only way back.
4. **(medium) "Water now" and "Save watering" can hang and can duplicate.** The app sets no request timeout, so a stuck request leaves the button on "Watering…" and disabled indefinitely. Saves also have no duplicate protection: two identical requests I sent created two separate waterings, so retrying after a timeout would record the watering twice.
5. **(low) Watering two beds quickly re-enables the second bed's button too early.** All beds share one "busy" marker. When the first bed finishes, the second bed's button turns back on while its request is still running, so a second click records a duplicate. The two beds' success and error messages also overwrite each other.
6. **(low) If the beds list fails to load, the Waterings filter fails silently.** The dropdown just shows "All beds" and no error appears.
7. **(low) The filter can disagree with the URL.** The filter is read from the URL only once when the page opens. Going from a bed's "Watering history" link to the "Waterings" nav link leaves the list filtered while the URL shows no filter.
8. **(low) Today's date can be refused as "in the future".** The server checks the date against its own clock, while the form defaults to the browser's date. A user in a time zone ahead of the server would see today refused. "Water now" also stores the server's date while showing the time in the user's zone, so the two can disagree.
9. **(low) Long bed names may cause sideways scrolling at 375 px.** The waterings tables don't wrap long single words, so a 60-character bed name with no spaces would push the table past the screen edge.
